resources.string: Keep the ship\'s radio till the phone strikes up

With the sound through myCar, the ship\'s radio, or whatever it was playing, sails on until something plays on the phone. Off, the ship hands its speakers to myCar, and falls quiet, as soon as it\'s boarded.
With the sound through myCar, the ship\'s radio sails on until you strike up a shanty on the phone, instead of falling quiet as soon as the ship\'s boarded
